title: Coral Coast Caravan
style: Australian comedy pop with swing-big-band swagger, fast polka guitar licks, beatboxed percussion, harmonica riffs as a hook instrument, and playful dembow-skip bounce; verse rides cheeky character banter, pre-chorus strips to claps and harmonica, chorus lands with gang vocals and shouted family chants. Voices are stacked like instruments, with call-and-response ad-libs, short delay throws on punchlines, and bright punchy mix with dusty road-trip texture., polka, big band, oi, comedy, bounce, happy, swing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
West Australian, coast to coast
Caravan home, we boast and roast
Tree feel true and tall out back
Mate, what 2am? I need a snack

[Michelle]
Mishy Mish Mash, coach on court
Pickleball queen in a caravan sport
Sweet new car? Nah, got the van
No computer says no, that’s the plan

[Ruby]
Ruby roo roo, paint on my hands
My art stays with me, wherever I land
Pink and grey galah on the tin roof, hey
I draw the whole coast in a single day

[Wesley]
Wez, Wezza, gamer pro coach
“and?” I say, then I take the approach
Crushed your car? “Sweet new car, nah mate”
“Insured, yeah” — that’s how we skate

[Pre-Chorus]
[Corey]
And if the fire burns the park to the ground

[Michelle]
Sorry luv, we don’t cover that sound

[Ruby]
No new park or car for you

[Wesley]
Then we clap twice and bounce right through

[Chorus]
All: Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)
All: Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)

[Corey]
Never ending holiday

[Ruby]
Coral coast, we stay

[Michelle]
Caravan heart, all day

[Wesley]
Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)

[Verse 2]
[Ashley]
Asher Ashley, I’m on the run
Off she goes, super dog speed, fun
Where’s Micha? I’m asking the track
Two dogs with lots of frogs in the back

[Aussie]
Mate, I sniff the sand, I sniff the tin
I hear a lizard say, “Let the race begin”
Mini black sniffer poodle, here I go
Aussie, aussie, aussie — I’m in the know

[Corey]
Corey codes the super intelligence
Reversing forward engineering, make it make sense
Upside down with Mrs Squiggle in the chair
Wesley laughs like “bro, you’re nearly there”

[Wesley]
What’s da pelican reckon? He’s got the facts
A Rotto quokka doing back-to-back tracks
Ruby roo roo roo, kanga bounce on cue
And Mishy Mish Mash says, “Walk it through”

[Pre-Chorus]
[Michelle]
Build it, flip it, pass it round

[Ruby]
Draw it, stick it, on the ground

[Wesley]
If the answer’s weird, then it’s our best friend

[Corey]
We’re back in the van till the very end

[Chorus]
All: Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)
All: Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)

[Michelle]
Never ending holiday

[Ruby]
Coral coast, we stay

[Wesley]
Caravan heart, all day

[Corey]
Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)

[Bridge]
[Corey]
Pink and grey galah, micha, wezza, bo bo, aye i i

[Ruby]
Roo roo roo, kanga bounce, let it fly

[Michelle]
Mishy Mish Mash, laugh till we shake

[Wesley]
Mi mini black sniffer poodle, no mistake

[Ashley]
Asher Ashley where’s micha?

[Aussie]
Off she goes super dog speed

[All]
2 dogs with lots of frogs
Ha ha ha, that’s all we need

[Final Chorus]
All: Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)
All: Aussie Aussie Aussie
(all: oi oi oi)

[Corey]
Never ending holiday

[Ruby]
Cor
